direct_ancestors.description: Level 1 Cell DIVE dataset from the left distal lower leg with moderate sun exposure related damage (by H&E evaluation) of a 53-year-old white female donor. Multiplexed immunofluorescence images were collected with the IN Cell 2200 as part of the NIH funded Human Biomolecular Atlas Program (HuBMAP). There are 26 serial sections in this dataset.
